categories.main_business_segments: Suntar Environmental Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two segments: membrane technology applications and water investment operations. The membrane technology segment includes industrial liquid separation, membrane water treatment, environmental engineering, membrane spare parts, and household water purification devices. The water investment operations segment focuses on municipal sewage treatment plant investment and management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company develops advanced inorganic non-metallic membrane materials and high-performance composite membranes, including nanofiltration cores, ceramic membranes, hollow fiber membranes, MBR membranes, spiral membranes, and graphene membranes. It integrates membrane materials, components, equipment, software, and applications into a complete membrane industry chain. Production involves proprietary membrane material fabrication, membrane component assembly, and system integration, with some standardized parts outsourced under strict quality control. The company also employs advanced membrane separation technologies such as ultrafiltration, nanofiltration, reverse osmosis, and membrane bioreactors.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Suntar serves industrial customers in pharmaceuticals, chemical engineering, food and beverage, biopharmaceuticals, metallurgy, petrochemicals, and lithium extraction from salt lakes. It also serves municipal water management departments and end consumers in household water purification. Key markets include industrial liquid separation, product purification, wastewater resource recovery, and drinking water safety assurance.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Fujian (Xiamen and Zhangzhou), Shaanxi (Yan'an), Jilin (Meihekou), and Henan (Xuchang). It has expanded overseas with subsidiaries and offices in Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam, Indonesia, Thailand, and the Middle East, focusing on Southeast Asia and Middle Eastern membrane water treatment markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Suntar operates across the membrane industry supply chain, from upstream membrane material research and production to midstream membrane component and equipment manufacturing, and downstream membrane system integration and application services. It also engages in municipal water treatment plant investment and operation, positioning itself both as a technology/materials supplier and as a service provider in water treatment operations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous technological innovation with a proprietary RDPA (Research-Development-Pilot-Application) system. R&D focuses on enhancing membrane material performance, developing new membrane types like graphene and nanofiltration membranes, improving membrane application processes, and expanding membrane use in emerging sectors such as lithium extraction, synthetic biology, petrochemicals, and health-related water purification. It also invests in expanding production capacity and overseas market development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through sales of membrane materials, components, and integrated membrane equipment, along with providing customized membrane technology solutions and after-sales services. The water investment segment earns revenue from municipal sewage treatment service fees based on treated water volume and pricing, under various contractual models including EPC, BOT, BT, and TOT. The company also sells household water purification devices and membrane spare parts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Suntar is a leading domestic membrane technology company in China, recognized as a pioneer in industrial membrane applications and water treatment solutions. It holds a strong market position with advanced proprietary technologies and comprehensive industry chain coverage. The company competes with international membrane technology firms but leverages local market knowledge, innovation, and integrated solutions to maintain competitive advantages. It is acknowledged as a national 'specialized and innovative' enterprise and a 'single champion' in manufacturing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Suntar achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.45 billion, a 15.2% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 254 million, up 16.55%. Total assets grew by 4.52% to RMB 5.54 billion. The company maintains steady growth driven by membrane technology applications and water investment operations, with expanding production capacity and overseas market penetration. Basic and diluted earnings per share increased by 16.92%. R&D investment accounted for 4.52% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Suntar offers comprehensive membrane industry chain solutions from materials to applications, emphasizing proprietary advanced membrane materials with superior filtration performance, durability, and anti-fouling properties. Its graphene-modified membranes and nanofiltration cores provide selective separation of harmful substances while retaining beneficial minerals, outperforming imported alternatives. The company integrates membrane technology with customized software and system engineering to deliver efficient, clean production and green manufacturing solutions, supporting industrial upgrades and environmental protection. Its water treatment operations utilize self-developed MBR membrane technology to enhance effluent quality and operational efficiency.
